intro: The London board's image block, second pass: https://claude.ai/artifact/CbemmwUeW5qGEmEFog7ezz. The six infographics are baked in the styles you picked: sticker for the four steps, the prices and the breed comparison; chalk for the delivery route and the paperwork folder; comic for the health checks. Each draft shows its fingerprint (sha12). In block 7, pick each infographic's draft in place of the photo pre-filled at STOP 3, check the other 29 photos, then approve on the board. This question records that you have.

questions.context: Recommended: (a). Why: every body heading and the hero has a slot. The 29 photos are your own served images, and the six infographics carry only figures from the data files (prices, deposit, delivery band, guarantee, breed standards). Trade-off: you are seeing the six infographics as images for the first time. Phones get their own stacked version of each, which the board does not show; it ships unchanged next to the image you approve.
